authority: User: run revised T3 on H discovery by scribe, freeze frames and variants, apply unchanged to H/F confirmation; preserve all failures
method: T3-multiword-v2-attempt1; unchanged qualified engine and thresholds

confirmation.when: only after both candidate freeze files and hashes saved
confirmation.no_candidate: terminal; do not parse that scribe confirmation bodies or run shuffles
confirmation.support: >=8 represented folios per cell; absent or incomplete P paragraphs excluded and logged; never force cross-reading alignment
confirmation.paragraphs: original frozen v8 tokenizer; group folio/place in source order, close on explicit =, discard unterminated tails; original unknown slots remain barriers
confirmation.correction: Holm2 over scribes within H and within F, inactive/unscoreable slots internal p1; report no measured p for inactive cells
confirmation.headline: same scribe meets frozen predictions and Holm p<.05 in H and F

custody.qualification: limited pass only; exposed Latin, native default controls, discovery-derived geometries; no independent manuscript-sized positive power estimate
custody.known_exposure: Prior single-word H discovery and source context already known; v8 is retrospective in text with an internal fixed folio split
